traits.silhouette: a lean lion crouched to spring, forelegs braced forward and chest low, a long serpent tail arching up over the back, and a goat neck and head rising from the middle of the spine
traits.head: a lion head with a wide-open roaring mouth and fangs, a heavy brow, round ears, framed by a big spiky mane that rays out round the face; the goat head on the back has a narrow muzzle, a little beard and long horns swept back
traits.limbs: four lion legs, lean and sinewy, big round paws with claws; the forelegs set wide and forward
traits.hide: short tawny lion coat, a ridge of bristles down the spine, ribs showing on the flank, a darker shaggy mane; the tail is a scaled snake ending in a snake head that turns to bite
traits.colours: tawny gold body, a darker red-brown mane, a dark brown goat, a green-scaled serpent tail with a pale belly
child: a lion with a big mane
a goat head sticking out of its back
